name: OCPN Comparison
author: István Koren
description: Compares two Object-Centric Petri Nets per object type. It reports τ-abstracted directly-follows and reachability footprints, shared activities, variable-arc differences, and reciprocal bounded behavioral coverage. The result is an auditable comparison report, not a picture-only diff.

maxVariantLength.title: Bounded variant length
maxVariantLength.description: Maximum visible-activity length enumerated for reciprocal behavioral coverage. This bounds graph-walk exploration; it is not an exact Petri-net alignment.

maxVariants.title: Maximum variants
maxVariants.description: Safety cap per object type while enumerating τ-abstracted visible variants.

authors.name: István Koren
authors.affiliation: ELTE University Budapest, Data Science and Engineering

citation.text: The report combines behavioral-profile ideas (Weidlich, Polyvyanyy, Mendling and Weske, 2011) with OCPN-aware conformance concepts (Gianola, Montali and Winkler, 2023).
